# unifi_setting_element_adopt (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_element_adopt` resource manages Element Adoption settings for a UniFi site, allowing UniFi Elements devices to be adopted over a dedicated SSID and pre-shared key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_element_adopt" "example" {
  # Enable adoption of UniFi Elements devices
  enabled = true

  # Dedicated SSID and pre-shared key used for Element adoption.
  # Only used when enabled. The PSK is sensitive.
  x_element_essid = "element-adopt"
  x_element_psk   = "change-me-please"

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to site configured in provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Element adoption is enabled.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `x_element_essid` (String) The SSID used for Element adoption. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `x_element_psk` (String, Sensitive) The pre-shared key used for Element adoption. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
